title: PhoneNumber scalar is not fully compatible with E.164 format so updated regex to support phone number with extension

expectedFindings.description: The new regex `\d+\)?((\-|\x20)?\d+)+$` nests quantifiers with an optional separator, so it backtracks exponentially. About 30 digits plus one bad character blocks the thread for seconds, during GraphQL validation, before any auth runs.

mustNotSkip.reason: The one-line regex change, hidden behind about 120 lines of rewritten tests.

shouldSkip.reason: Rewritten test cases. None of them exercises backtracking.

evidence.note: Advisory: PhoneNumber scalar ReDoS, affected >= 1.24.1; "Introduced by #2719 (c7f58da16)".
Security fix: replaces the regex with an equivalent linear-time pattern.
